original.statement: With Dex SSO, Argo CD 3.0 bases the RBAC subject on the federated_claims.user_id claim (requesting the federated:id scope) instead of the sub claim, so RBAC policies that reference the Dex sub claim must be updated to keep the same access.

decision.reason: [ev-0b6150153730] says that with Dex, Argo CD used the `sub` claim as the RBAC subject. It says the new behavior bases the subject on the `federated_claims.user_id` claim instead, requesting the `federated:id` scope. The same Dex setup now gives a different meaning, so behavior-changed fits, with before = sub claim and after = federated_claims.user_id claim. protocol-behavior with the kebab-case name dex-rbac-subject-claim uses only words from the evidence and names the subject clearly.
